planets.name: TOI-1696 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1696 with a 2.5-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1696 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1696. Its orbit and size follow Mori et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
